title: Replace disconnected consultancy work with one connected workflow.
description: LabourFlow brings the work currently spread across Excel, WhatsApp, email, physical files and government portals into one organized platform.

items.title: One Dashboard for Every Client
items.description: See client information, compliance status, deadlines, tasks and activity from one centralized workspace.

items.title: Deadlines Tracked Automatically
items.description: Keep PF, ESI, PT, LWF, returns, licence renewals and other recurring obligations visible with automated reminders.

items.title: Payroll From Attendance to Outputs
items.description: Upload attendance, process payroll and generate payslips and statutory outputs through one connected workflow.

items.title: Every Client Record in One Place
items.description: Keep licences, certificates, agreements, statutory records and other documents organized with expiry tracking and search.

items.title: Fewer Manual Follow-Ups
items.description: Automate attendance requests, deadline alerts and document renewal reminders through WhatsApp and email.

items.title: Inspection-Ready Records
items.description: Bring documents, filings and compliance history together so your team can prepare for inspections without searching through multiple systems.
